nodes.label: interactiveRoll is used only for roller:'player'
nodes.rationale: roller:'dm' and an omitted roller both fall through to the engine even when a hook is registered, so enemy rolls never land on the player's dice tray. An ok:false from the hook surfaces as an isError CallToolResult carrying ERROR text.

nodes.label: roll_dice schema demands a 3-6 word reason, never a sentence
nodes.rationale: Bug fix: a sentence-length reason pushed the roll result off screen.

nodes.label: onLedger fires exactly once per successful gain/loss, never on failure
nodes.rationale: The web front-end renders a 'YOU GAINED' toast from the structured LedgerDelta instead of parsing engine message strings. Rejected amounts, unaffordable spends and failed removals must emit nothing, and absent hooks must never throw.

nodes.label: Gold direction comes from the tool, not the sign of the amount
nodes.rationale: The bug this pair of tools exists to make impossible: a live referee answered 'I pocket the ten gold pieces' with modify_gold(-10), so looting a corpse left the hero poorer. award_gold(-10) must still make them richer.

nodes.label: defeat_foe pays XP and records the foe in one call
nodes.rationale: Ten live turns killed a bandit on a natural 20, confirmed and looted the body, and XP never left 0 because award_xp is bookkeeping a small model drops. Non-lethal outcomes map to the right NPC status ('fled' -> missing, 'surrendered' -> alive) and a level-up still reports through the ledger.

nodes.label: defeat_foe matches a loosely-named foe already on the roster
nodes.rationale: A live kill of the world's 'Trail bandit' came back as 'Bandit', leaving two records -- one dead, one still walking around. When the reference is ambiguous (two bandits) it creates a separate record rather than killing the wrong NPC.

nodes.label: upsert_quest round-trips reward and never clears it on update
